Vocal isolation

Hears the voice, not the noise.

Every file is split into vocals and instrumental first, so transcription locks onto speech even over loud music. You get both tracks back as downloads.

Speaker-aware

Knows who is talking.

Diarization separates speakers before a single word is transcribed.

Studio editor

Edit like a video editor.

Timeline, drag-to-retime, split, undo, and a live preview.
